artifacts.rationale: Strong associations with lipids (non-HDL, ApoB) and coronary artery disorder. A frameshift variant (gwas_10) with high L2G score links the gene to lower ApoB, suggesting inhibition is beneficial.

artifacts.rationale: No Mendelian diseases are caused by loss-of-function (LoF) variants across 13 categories. GWAS signals are primarily metabolic biomarkers or anthropometric traits without clear safety risks.

needs.query: Is the gene LoF-intolerant (e.g., pLI > 0.9 or low LOEUF)?

artifacts.rationale: Exceptional tolerance metrics (LOEUF 1.45, pLI 0) and lack of cell-line dependency strongly suggest that lifelong inhibition would be well-tolerated in humans.
